## Automated Tests Required

All suites follow `tests/README.md`: file `[system]_[feature]_test.gd`, function `test_[scenario]_[expected]`; gameplay numbers from `TestConstants`, never literals (boundary-value tests excepted); `auto_free(...)` on every Node; doubles from `tests/helpers/`. Rules code is constructed directly in `tests/unit/**`, never through `Boot`.

### RNG-001 RngStream — Logic
**Test file paths**: `tests/unit/rng_event_log/rng_engine_pins_test.gd` (gate condition 7 pin), `tests/unit/rng_event_log/rng_stream_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- Engine golden pin: two `RandomNumberGenerator` seeded `42`, 100 `randi()` each, sequences identical, first three `492690617, 1919685028, 3561993920`, every value in `[0, 2^32 − 1]`; failure message names the engine version.
- F4 draw counts: `randi_range`, `randf`, `weighted_pick` = 1 draw; `shuffle(a)` = `n − 1` draws (Fisher–Yates `j = randi_range(0, i)`, `i = n−1 … 1`).
- F4 example trace with a scripted `randi32()`: `shuffle([A,B,C,D])` with `j = 1, 0, 1` → `[C,D,A,B]`, 3 draws; `weighted_pick([5,0,15])` with `r = 7` → index 2.
- Distribution: `weighted_pick([5,0,15])` × 10,000 at seed 42 → index 1 never, index 2 in 7,200–7,800, `draws == 10,000` (deterministic — fixed seed).
- `fork("x")` twice: same object, name `<parent>/x`, parent `draws` +1 total.

**Edge cases to cover** (GDD rng-event-log Edge Cases → Streams):
- `shuffle` of 0 and 1 elements: 0 draws.
- `randi_range` with `lo > hi`, and with span > 65,536: returns `lo`, no draw (release path; debug asserts — test the release behaviour via the non-asserting path or `assert_failure`, as the helper self-test does).
- `weighted_pick` with `[]`, a negative weight, total 0, total > 65,536: returns `-1`, no draw.
- Same-label `fork` is idempotent (no extra draw on retry).

**Estimated test count**: ~14 unit tests

### BAI-001 PlannerTask seam — Logic
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/boss_ai/boss_ai_planner_task_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- `ImmediatePlannerTask.start(work)` runs `work.call()` inside `start()`; then `poll() == true`, `is_live() == false`, `result()` is the work's value (non-suspending coroutine, engine-validation claim 11).
- `PlannerTask` is `@abstract` (`start`, `poll`); base `checkpoint()` is a no-op so `await planner.checkpoint()` returns immediately; `result()` is `null` when the work errored; `is_live()` true from `start()` until finished.
- A subclass missing an override fails to parse — verify with `.claude/scripts/godot-parse-check.gd` on a fixture script, not inside the suite (a non-parsing script in `tests/` exits the run with 105).
- `TimeSlicedPlannerTask`: `start()` runs until the first over-budget `checkpoint()`; each `poll()` resets the slice clock, resumes via `_resume.emit()`, returns `_done`.
- `WorkerPoolPlannerTask` against a **fake pool**: `poll()` false while `is_task_completed(id)` false; `wait_for_task_completion(id)` called exactly once; later `poll()` true with no further pool calls. `tests/unit/**` never starts a real worker (TD-012).

**Edge cases to cover**: `poll()` before `start()`; `poll()` called many times after completion (no pool call); work that errors (result `null`).

**QA finding — time-dependent assertion**: AC 2 states "the longest slice is ≤ `slice_ms` + one evaluation (Probe A: 2.09–2.11 ms)". As a wall-clock assertion this breaks the testing standard (no time-dependent assertions) and will flake on a loaded CI runner. Recommended for `/story-readiness` / `/dev-story`: inject the slice clock (a scripted `Callable` returning usec) so the test asserts *where* the coroutine yields, deterministically; print the measured real slice as an observation only. Not resolved here.
**Estimated test count**: ~10 unit tests

### BOOT-003 MetaStub — Logic
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/boot/boot_meta_stub_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- `MetaStub.new(db)` with a `CardDatabase` **test double** (card-database 006 not in sprint) exposing `config("profile_defaults")`, `heroes()`, `treasure_pool()`; `load_status() == FRESH`; all heroes/treasures/keys unlocked; `stats_for_hero` zeros, `last_hero_id()` null, `run_log()` / `pending_notifications()` `[]`.

### BOOT-004 Boot composition root — Integration
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/boot/boot_composition_test.gd` (alongside the existing `boot_scene_test.gd`)
**What to test**:
- `project.godot [autoload]` holds exactly one entry, `Boot` (parse the file; gate G4); `Boot._ready()` inert; `Boot.booted == false` after the suite starts (QQ-04 — whether gdUnit4 headless instantiates autoloads is NOT SOURCEABLE; the test records which).
- `boot(overrides)` runs steps 2–4 in order: `CardDatabase` constructed and `load(validators)` called; `Services.meta` is `MetaStub.new(card_database)`; `Services.profile_store == null`; `Services.settings_bus` is the same object as `Services.meta.settings_bus`; `booted = true`; returns `BootResult {ok, report, load_status}`.
- Idempotent: second `boot()` re-runs no `load()` (count calls on the double), `services()` returns the same instance.
- Overrides: `boot({meta: MetaStub.new(...)})` and `boot({card_database: <double>})` place the given object; `Services` has exactly the four fields and no methods.
- Failed load: double whose `load()` ends `Failed` → `ok == false`, `report` is the `ValidationReport`, `load_status == &"Failed"`, no crash, no `Services.meta` construction that reads data.
- `Boot` holds no `MatchState`/`RunState`/deck/floor field (introspect property list).

**Edge cases**: `boot({})` vs no-arg; override with an object of the wrong type (out of AC scope — note only).
**Timing**: the 200 ms `data_load_budget_ms` check is "measured and printed, advisory" — print it, do **not** assert on it (see Cross-cutting 2).
**Estimated test count**: ~8 integration tests

**Test file path**: `tests/unit/match_rules/match_rules_data_model_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- AC-41: grep `src/` for literal values of the F9 constants (`BOARD_SIZE`, `HAND_SIZE`, `STARTING_HAND_PLAYER`, `STARTING_HAND_BOSS`, `MAX_MANA`, `HERO_POWER_COST`, `MULLIGAN_ROUNDS`, `TURN_CAP`, `RESOLUTION_STEP_CAP`, `MAX_ATTACKS_CAP`) and Tuning Knobs (`STARTING_HEALTH_PLAYER`, `FATIGUE_BASE`, `FATIGUE_STEP`); every value read from `match_rules.json` via `rules_config`. Also assert `assets/data/match_rules.json` defaults equal the Tuning Knobs "Current value" column (via `TestConstants`) and lie in each "Safe range".

### MR-002 HookRegistry — Logic (tier full)
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/match_rules/match_rules_hook_registry_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- Install order: `t_a`, `t_b` (two `modify_cost` effects each), `boss_p` (one `on_turn_start` + one `modify_cost`) → `entries(&"modify_cost")` = five entries in order `t_a[0], t_a[1], t_b[0], t_b[1], boss_p[…]`, each exactly `{host_kind, host_id, side, effect_id, effect, state}` (`GameAssertions.assert_has_keys`), `side` = `MatchFactory.SIDE_*`; `entry_count() == 6`; `hosts()` lists 3 with `state`; no `priority`/`weight`/`order`/`is_enabled`/`duration_turns`/`stacks`.
- Duplicate host: `install(t_a_again)` → `false`, counts and entries unchanged; fresh registry from same list equals the first.
- Fold: scripted `fold_entry` deltas −1, −1, −1 on input 1 → `−2` (no clamp in the fold); entry *n* output is entry *n+1* input; same `side` and same `ctx` object on each call; empty point returns input unchanged; `set 2` then `mul 3` → `6`.
- Copy: mutate an entry's `effect` in the copy → original unchanged; copy's evaluators unset (fold returns input, `run_triggers` runs nothing); `entry_count()` matches; `gate()` returns `true` for every point; `GATE_POINTS` empty.

**Edge cases to cover** (card-effects Edge Cases → Hooks: two disagreeing value hooks fold to net 0, engine floors only after the fold — F1): a +1 and −1 pair yields the input unchanged; installer with zero effects.
**Estimated test count**: ~10 unit tests

### CDB-001 Manifest, parse and envelope — Logic
**Test file paths**: `tests/unit/card_database/card_database_pipeline_test.gd`, `tests/unit/card_database/card_database_parse_error_test.gd`, `tests/unit/card_database/card_database_single_parser_test.gd`
**What to test**:
- `FILE_MANIFEST`: one row `{name, class, record_type, required, owner}` per DD-T01/CR-1 file — 8 card sets (`war`, `neutral`, `boss` required; 5 optional), 5 definition files, 13 config files (`assert_no_duplicates` on names).
- Missing `card_database.json` in a fixture root → `E_MISSING_FILE` naming it, state `Failed`, no defaults path; unexpected `.json` → `W_UNKNOWN_FILE`, not loaded.
- Malformed JSON → `E_PARSE` with file, non-zero line, parser message where given; other files still processed (no fail-fast). Report entry shape `{severity, code, file, record_id|null, field|null, message}`; `entries()` sorted by file then record id (`assert_sorted_ascending`).
- `schema_version` 0 and 2 (separate runs) → `E_SCHEMA_VERSION` with found and expected (1), state `Failed`; definition `records` not an array, config carrying `records` instead of `config` → `E_PARSE`.
- Single parser: `SCHEMA_VERSION_CURRENT` the one constant (mirrored by `TestConstants.SCHEMA_VERSION_CURRENT`); grep `src/` outside `src/core/data/` for `FileAccess.open("res://assets/data/`, `JSON.parse_string`, `JSON.new().parse`, `load("res://assets/data/` → zero hits.

**Edge cases to cover** (GDD card-database Edge Cases → Versions and files): `schema_version` missing (→ `E_SCHEMA_VERSION` / `E_PARSE`); optional set file absent (no error); required set file absent; set file with empty `records` (`W_EMPTY_SET` — stage 4 cross-refs are later stories, so only the warning is in scope).
**File I/O note**: the testing standard says unit tests do no file I/O; these tests read fixture roots by design (ADR-0002 verification item 1 — the parse-error line is NOT SOURCEABLE and this test is its proof). Keep fixtures under `tests/fixtures/card_database/` and inject the root path; flag at `/code-review` if fixtures are written at runtime.
**Estimated test count**: ~14 unit tests

1. **Automated suite**: `godot --headless --path . --import`, then exactly `commands.test`; exit 0, and the output does not contain `No test cases found` (exit 0 with no tests is not a pass); exit 101 (leaked nodes) treated as a failure, matching CI.
2. **Launch**: `timeout 30 godot --headless --quit-after 5` exits 0 with no `SCRIPT ERROR` — now with the `Boot` autoload in `project.godot` (BOOT-004 is the sprint's one change to what launches).
3. **Existing smoke suites still pass**: `tests/smoke/project_boot_smoke_test.gd`, `tests/integration/boot/boot_scene_test.gd`.
4. **Primary mechanic this sprint (critical-paths item 4)**: the 10 story suites above all present and green — RNG golden pin first (a failure there stops ADR-0003 work and goes to technical-director).
5. **Regression risk**: `tests/unit/framework/test_helpers_test.gd` still green — MR-001 swaps the `MatchFactory` record shapes (`TODO(E1 story)` marker) and RNG-001 shares the F4 contract with `TestRngStream`; a helper drift shows here.
6. **Gates**: no second autoload (G4); no `Boot`/`Services` reference under `src/core/**` (minus `boot.gd`), `src/gameplay/**`, `src/ai/**` (G3); G7 clean after the spike.
7. **CI**: `.github/workflows/tests.yml` green on the sprint PR (same command; no export job — Windows export is not in CI, gate condition 8, no story).

Performance (critical-paths item 7–8): N/A — nothing renders or loops. The BOOT-004 data-load time is printed, not gated.

*Smoke tests are verified by the developer via `/smoke-check sprint` after implementation. `tests/smoke/critical-paths.md` item 4 is still a placeholder; update it when the first playable mechanic lands.*

## Cross-cutting items

1. **CE-001 PROCEED/PIVOT is recorded evidence.** The outcome is not a test result; it is a document (`docs/architecture/spikes/2026-11-DD-dsl-effect-spike.md`) and it gates later work: PIVOT re-blocks card-effects 006–016 and pushes the first playable. Sprint DoD and `/story-done` for CE-001 require the record, the passing spike suite, and AC-S3's cleanup. Surface the outcome to Jacob the day it lands.
2. **Perf / timing-assertion caveat — risk, not a sprint-1 item.** The testing standard forbids time-dependent assertions, yet later stories carry hard timing guardrails (match-rules 018 perf suite under `tests/performance/`, card-effects 016, RNG story 010 `restore` ≤ 5 ms, hook fold < 0.05 ms, `RulesEngine.submit()` ≤ 5 ms, planner p95). `commands.test -a res://tests` would pick up `tests/performance/` and run timing checks on shared `ubuntu-latest` runners, where they flake. Recommendation for the sprint that first lands a perf story: a separate CI job (or `-a res://tests/unit -a res://tests/integration -a res://tests/smoke` in the main job plus a perf job with retries / thresholds reported as observations). In sprint 1 the only timing items are BOOT-004's printed 200 ms load (advisory, not asserted) and BAI-001 AC 2 (see the QA finding in its section — make it deterministic with an injected clock).

## Definition of Done — This Sprint

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified — via automated test result OR documented evidence (CE-001: the spike record)
